text_blocks.snippet: Tami Roman has spoken publicly about her struggles with body dysmorphic disorder (BDD). She was diagnosed with BDD in 2008, although she believes she has experienced symptoms since she was 13. Roman has described it as a mental disorder where she fixates on perceived flaws in her appearance, and this can lead to an inaccurate perception of her own body. She has also mentioned that her BDD is trauma-based, stemming from a negative experience at a modeling agency when she was younger.
